evidence_slice: Historic England Heritage Gateway record MDV84270, sourced from the Devon and Dartmoor Historic Environment Record, identifies 12 and 13 Lyndhurst Road, Exeter as a pair of mid-19th-century Italianate villas and states that No. 13 is now a school. The record gives Easting/Northing 293088, 092209, latitude/longitude 50.719641, -3.515869, protected status Listed Building, and cites Historic England NHLE 1390700. It provides point/location coordinates and source references but no Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates or record-level footprint geometry.
